name: Veldtmark ThermaShift Scarf — Adaptive Weight
description: A wide-format scarf woven from phase-change yarn that passively thickens in cold air and compresses flat in warmth, eliminating the need to swap accessories mid-day. Deep rust-red with irregular indigo stripe detailing drawn from West African kente geometry remixed through a Japanese ikat technique. Long enough to wrap as a cowl, hood, or shoulder drape depending on the moment.
functionality: Passive thermal regulation via phase-change fiber; multi-wrap geometry for hood, cowl, or drape configuration.
what_it_says: You invest in things that solve problems quietly, without fuss or visible effort.
story_hooks: Someone embroidered a single character in Amharic script near one end — a name, maybe, or a word of protection.
The phase-change yarn responds slightly faster than it should in extreme cold, suggesting a non-standard batch origin.
